g.aria-label: 100% train acc on noise ⇒ class-only VC bounds B(ℱ,n) ≥ 0.9 are vacuous
Square H has s_min ≈ 10⁻⁵–10⁻³ (explodes ‖W‖); h ≫ n heals s_min & shrinks norm
Squared-loss GD from w₀ = 0 stays in row(H) ⇒ converges to min-‖w‖₂ fit
Cross-entropy GD sends ‖w_t‖ → ∞ while w_t/‖w_t‖ → hard-margin SVM
SGD fits coherent clean structure in ~20 epochs before memorizing noise
